title: VanillaCream
body: VanillaCream is a Minecraft mod with something vanilla-styled. ## Craftable stones Why diorite can be crafted, but calcite not? ### Calcite Diorite + Dripstone Block ### Deepslate Stone + Basalt ### Tuff Andesite + Basalt ### Blackstone 8 * Basalt + Black Dye ## Baguette A bigger bread but with the same ingredients. (6 food level, 7.2 saturation.) ## Bring lost flowers back Bring [Rose](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Poppy#History), [Cyan Rose](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Poppy#History) and [Paeonia](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Paeonia) back! Rose have 1/10 chance of spawning as Cyan Rose, a rare variant of Rose. They generate in `#vanillacream:has_rose` biomes. Paeonia generates in `#vanillacream:has_paeonia` biomes. Suspicious Stew Effects: - Rose: darkness - Cyan Rose: Night vision - Paeonia: Dig speed ## More Jack‐o'‐lanterns Redstone torches and soul torches are used to create pumpkin lanterns. ### Redstone Jack o'Lantern A redstone signal source provides 15 signal level if you are looking at its face. ### Soul Jack o'Lantern ## An animal don't want to grow Do you like a baby animal? Rename it to `Peter_Pan`, and it will always show as a baby. (Only available to `#vanillacream:can_grow` entity types.) Inspired by `First Drop 2026`.
